entry.title: SAP MDK iOS app crashes at launch on macOS Tahoe / Xcode 26 due to ArcGIS framework symbol mismatch
entry.content:
🧩 Problem Statement

SAP Mobile Development Kit (MDK) iOS application fails to launch on iOS Simulator when built using macOS Tahoe (26.x) and Xcode 26.x.
The application builds successfully, but crashes immediately at runtime with a dyld symbol not found error related to ArcGIS.framework and MapFramework.framework.

📝 Case Explanation 

We are developing an SAP Asset Manager–based MDK application (SvcAssetMgr) using SAP MDK SDK 25.9.1

Environment

  • macOS: Tahoe 26.2

  • Xcode: 26.0.1

  • MDK SDK: 25.9.1

  • NativeScript CLI: 8.9.5

  • Target Platform: iOS Simulator (iOS 26.0)

  • Deployment Target: iOS 17.0

Issue Description

  • The application builds successfully using ns build ios

  • CocoaPods installation and linking complete without errors

  • However, when launching the app on the iOS Simulator, the app terminates immediately

  • macOS displays the message:
    “SvcAssetMgr cannot be opened because of a problem”

On checking the simulator logs and crash output, the following dyld runtime error is consistently observed:

Symbol not found: _$s6ArcGIS7FeatureC10attributesSDySSs8Sendable_pGvgTj Referenced from: MapFramework.framework/MapFramework Expected in: ArcGIS.framework/ArcGIS

This indicates a binary incompatibility where:

  • MapFramework.framework expects a newer ArcGIS symbol

  • The ArcGIS.framework loaded at runtime does not contain this symbol

The crash happens before application code execution, during dynamic linking.

Observations

  • Multiple clean rebuilds were performed:

    • Removed platforms, node_modules, hooks

    • Cleared Xcode DerivedData

    • Reset iOS Simulator

    • Reinstalled MDK SDK using install.command

  • Deployment target updated to iOS 17.0

  • Issue persists consistently on macOS Tahoe 26.2 + Xcode 26.0.2

  • The problem appears to be caused by ArcGIS framework version mismatch packaged with MDK iOS extensions

  • The issue does not appear to be application-specific, but related to MDK iOS framework packaging and compatibility with newer Xcode/macOS

Expected Result

The MDK iOS application should launch successfully on the iOS Simulator when built with:

  • macOS Tahoe 26.2

  • Xcode 26.0.2

  • MDK SDK 25.9.1

Actual Result

The application crashes at launch with a dyld symbol resolution failure involving ArcGIS frameworks.

Request

  • Please confirm:

    • The supported Xcode and macOS versions for MDK SDK 25.9.1

    • Whether the bundled ArcGIS.framework is fully compatible with the MapFramework.framework

  • Provide:

    • A fix, patch, or OSS note if this is a known issue

    • Guidance on the correct ArcGIS / MapFramework combination for Xcode 26.0.2

Any recommended workaround for macOS Tahoe 26.2
Regards,
Gopal Singh
